subject.title: feat: centralized filename encoding utility for multi-encoding Content-Disposition handling

question: Should OpenClaw standardize Content-Disposition and mojibake filename decoding in a shared media utility/API, or keep the recovery behavior plugin-local for now?
rationale: Current main has duplicated parsers and an open partial implementation, so the next step changes a shared media/plugin boundary rather than fixing a single confirmed runtime bug.

options.title: Approve shared decoder
options.body: Use the existing open PR direction as the first scoped shared utility, with maintainer-required follow-up for remaining channel paths.

options.title: Keep recovery plugin-local
options.body: Close or narrow the shared-decoder PR and keep only channel-owned fixes until a stronger core API need is demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Approve shared decoder
recommendation.body: Use the existing open PR direction as the first scoped shared utility, with maintainer-required follow-up for remaining channel paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main blame and media/file-surface work make this the best available maintainer-routing candidate from the inspected history.
